name: proxy
description: An HTTPS debugging proxy inside Claude Code: intercepts browser, iOS and Android traffic with its own CA, setup guides, a filterable request list and tools for Claude.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port the proxy listens on.

listen.title: Listen on
listen.description: local: this Mac only (browser, simulators, Android emulator). lan: also phones on the same network.

noDecrypt.title: Hosts not to decrypt
noDecrypt.description: Comma-separated hosts tunnelled untouched (pinned services); *.example.com covers subdomains.

maxFlows.title: Requests kept
maxFlows.description: How many of the latest requests the list keeps.

node.title: Node executable
node.description: The node binary that runs the proxy (18 or newer).
